name: Kumo no Aru Machi Zenpen
original_name: くものある町 前編
source:
It is not especially unusual, Four people who went to the same junior high school at a time come to know each other and act together.

It was the same after leaving a separate high school, and I found the time, gathered, and went out to play.

The same thing as this summer of the third year of high school which withdrew the examinee, the congratulations were planning to go to play by the busy time.

The sun was shining brightly, and the cicadas were singing――

Unforgettable memories of that summer――
translation:
并不是什么稀奇的事。同一所初中的四个学生，在相识之后，渐渐开始一起行动。

即使后来各自去了不同的高中，大家依然会抽空聚在一起，出去游玩。

到了成为应届考生的高三暑假，也还是一样。大家打算从忙碌的日子里挤出时间，再一起出去玩。

阳光耀眼，蝉鸣不息——

那个夏天，留下了无法忘怀的回忆——
